column1: # Gal Guardians: Demon Purge on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Inti Creates "Ice" engine on NVN, SDK 14.3.0, update 1.1.0 (v262144); modules main + subsdk0 (movie) + subsdk1 (GLSLC) + sdk.
# The game compiles 7 GLSL shaders at startup with GLSLC (subsdk1): runtime GLSLC capture on device (porter device_glslc).
# Initial experimental game profile drafted from binary analysis and survey report.
# Performance & power: async NVN replay, prime-core replay pinning, on-demand GPU turbo
# Native Android 2D action layout: D-pad only on bottom-left (stick_l, minus, ls, rs hidden),
# Attack (X) / Jump (A) / Sub-weapon (B) / Purge (Y) arc on right, Swap (ZL/ZR) & Sub-Weapon Switch (L/R) stacked cleanly on right,
# and a compact Compass Right Stick (stick_r) tucked beside Jump.
